title: KAITO — Idol / Manager?!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's see. It should be around here somewhere... Aha, there you are, laser lights!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It can shoot red, green and blue lasers. Alright, this should be able to give everything a dance-party feel to it like MEIKO said.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now to carry it over to the show stage.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm...?
I thought I heard someone's voice coming from the practice area just now.
Move your arms faster and raise them higher! Good, just like that!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I knew it. It's Haruka and Minori.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. They seem to be hard at work too.
Alright...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whew... I-I'm so tired...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You did great, Minori.
That last part went so well too. Try not to forget the way you raised your arms and timed everything just now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I won't! Thank you for helping me like this, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Also, I'm parched.
Where'd I put my tea... Oh no.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We practiced so long that my tea became lukewarm. I was really hoping that it would stay cold...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's not good for an idol to look so sad.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here, take one. I'm sure you're tired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you have drinks... They're cold too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm hoping that I got them just right. I wouldn't want you to come down with something by cooling off too fast.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'll take one as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ahh! That hits the spot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you very much, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
If you'll excuse me, I have other business to attend to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Business?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I was just in the middle of carrying some lights over to the stage MEIKO will be using for her show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
If that's the case, we're sorry for keeping you like this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, don't mind me.
I just wanted to give you two a little boost since you were both so hard at work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did you see the way Rin and Len turned just now?! Absolute perfection!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness too... Those two have been working so hard on how they turn...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The first time I met you in SEKAI, KAITO, I could tell just how much you wanted to help those around you in a way that made them shine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Helping everyone shine...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You're not just an idol, but a manager too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
I help with everything from managing everyone's schedules to stage effects and many other things behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you did mention how you liked being on stage and working behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. Being a manager and working behind the scenes gives me a better understanding of the practical side of things.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The practical side of things...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes. For example, schedules.
The others each have their own preferences and ways of doing things.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Take Rin.
She likes having as much time as possible set aside to practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: On the other hand, Miku and MEIKO prefer to schedule more time for rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. Some prefer to focus more on their craft while others prefer to simulate a real show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, but at the same time, they don't necessarily do these things consciously. To them, these things are entirely feel-based or subconscious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And putting together an actual schedule makes that very clear.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So whenever I do notice anything, I try to tell the others and work it into their respective schedules.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So you're saying that we stand to gain quite a lot in terms of skills or efficiency by shining a light on what we do subconsciously.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Precisely.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You can learn all about how a show functions from the other side, which in turn can make planning for a performance much simpler.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right. We just did an event in real life the other day, I learned all sorts of things about lighting and stuff.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's what I'm talking about! In my case, I'm doing this as sort of a hobby and for my own personal betterment.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, “hobby” may be putting it too lightly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO's rehearsal is about to start.
I should get this over to her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Again, sorry for keeping you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm glad we got a chance to talk to you, KAITO! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I had fun too.
Also, don't stay out too late, you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: We won't!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, I'll see you later.
